text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Phew! I sure sang my heart out! After putting my all into karaoke, I'm sure training is gonna to go great toda—

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text: Well, if it isn't Kita! We're holding a local enka singing competition, so why don't you come by and listen to some songs?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: An enka competition?! Awesome! I'll be there!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wow… "Tears Upon the Turf" is such a fantastic song!
choice_data_list: That title perfectly describes how I felt when you didn't arrive for practice.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer? What are you talking about practice fo—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! I can't believe it's already so late! I'm sorryyy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Kitasan Black genuinely didn't notice the time, so I give her a warning and tell her to be more careful in the future.
